Reviewers see Vapi as a fast, developer-friendly way to build and ship voice AI without assembling the full telephony, speech, and realtime stack themselves. Several say it helped them prototype receptionist flows, multi-agent systems, and production voice agents quickly. The main caveat is that production reliability still needs work: reviewers [...] Vapi makes it much easier to build production-ready AI voice agents without dealing with low-level telephony and speech infrastructure. The developer experience is excellent, integrations are straightforward, and it supports flexible workflows for voice assistants, customer support, sales, and automation.
